### This is the FREE Starter version

Shows the core trick: an AI reads any webpage and decides what's relevant - no CSS scraping, works on any site/language.

In this free version you edit the URL and criteria directly inside the nodes below (no config screen), and you run it manually (no schedule).

**Want the full version?** It adds:
- Daily automatic schedule
- Duplicate detection (never get alerted on the same item twice)
- One simple CONFIG screen (edit URL/criteria without touching code)
- Full setup README + support

Get it here: https://wlti.gumroad.com/l/ai-site-monitor ($39)

### 1. Fetch
Grabs the raw HTML of the page you want to monitor.

### 2. Extract
Sends the page content to Claude, which reads it and pulls out a structured list of items (title, description, link, date) - no custom scraper per site needed.

### 3. Score & Filter
Each item goes back to Claude to be judged against your criteria, written in plain English. Only items that score high enough move forward.

### 4. Notify
Builds an HTML summary of the approved items and emails it to you.
